feeds.title: Yale Climate Connections
feeds.description: Yale Climate Connections is a nonpartisan, multimedia service providing daily broadcast radio programming and original web-based reporting, commentary, and analysis on the issue of climate change, one of the greatest challenges and stories confronting modern society.

feeds.title: Climate Generation Blog
feeds.description: Read articles on climate literacy, climate change education, youth leadership and community engagement by Climate Generation. They empower individuals and communities to engage in solutions to climate change.

feeds.title: Greenpeace
feeds.description: Covers breaking news and commentary by Greenpeace. Greenpeace is an independent global campaigning organisation that acts to change attitudes and behaviours to protect and conserve the environment and promote peace. Greenpeace works to stop dangerous climate change and inspire an energy revolution.

feeds.title: Climate Change Dispatch
feeds.description: Read about human-caused global warming, our ever-changing climate, plus other environmental and science news, journal reviews, papers, renewables, ecology, politics, government and new technology at Climate Change Dispatch.

feeds.title: Climate Policy Initiative Blog
feeds.description: Articles on climate finance, energy finance and land use policies around the world by Climate Policy Initiative. CPI's mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change. Their vision is to build a sustainable, resilient, and inclusive global economy.

feeds.title: Shell Climate Change Blog
feeds.description: Read articles on climate change, resource alternatives, and global warming by David Hone. David is a Chief Climate Change Advisor for Shell. He has worked in the energy sector and has had a long-term interest in environmental issues. The views expressed in this blog and related publications belong to him.

feeds.title: Canary Media
feeds.description: Canary Media is an independent, nonprofit newsroom covering the transition to clean energy and solutions to the climate crisis. We report on how the world is decarbonizing - from electricity to transportation, buildings, and industry - with a critical focus on finding out what works and what doesn't.

feeds.title: The Ice Blog
feeds.description: The Ice Blog reports on the minutiae of the phenomenon of climate change at the poles and around the globe. Read how global activities and geopolitical situations affect the Earth's Temperature. Blogger Irene Quaile is an Ice researcher and climate change activist.

feeds.title: Columbia Law School Climate Law Blogs
feeds.description: Legal and policy analysis on a variety of climate-related issues from the Columbia Law School blog. Columbia Law School is renowned for the intellectual rigor of its curriculum and the groundbreaking scholarship of its faculty. Drawing strength from the vast interdisciplinary resources of our distinguished research university and the global stage of New York City.

feeds.title: Carbon Brief
feeds.description: Carbon Brief covers climate science, energy and policy, specialising in clear, data-driven articles to improve the understanding of climate change. We publish a wide range of content, including science explainers, interviews, analysis and factchecks, as well as daily and weekly email summaries of newspaper and online coverage.

feeds.title: Inside Climate News
feeds.description: Inside Climate News is a Pulitzer Prize-winning, a nonprofit, nonpartisan news organization that provides essential reporting and analysis on climate change, energy and the environment, for the public and for decision-makers. We serve as watchdogs of government, industry, and advocacy groups and hold them accountable for their policies and actions.

feeds.title: Climate Home News
feeds.description: Climate change news, analysis, commentary, video, and podcasts focused on developments in global climate politics. Climate Home News is an independent news site specialising in the international politics of the climate crisis.

feeds.title: GoClimate Blog
feeds.description: Articles on climate change and global warming. GoClimate is a social company created in 2017 with the sole purpose of making it easier to start living a climate-neutral life, to slow down the biggest threat to humanity and the planet as a whole climate change.

feeds.title: ClimateState
feeds.description: Covering the climate crisis and the solutions. Climate change media and news.

feeds.title: We Want Climate Action Now
feeds.description: Latest news and articles on Climate Change and ecological breakdown. The Climate Action Now believes that to limit climate change to 1.5 degrees Centigrade we must act now, today not tomorrow.

feeds.title: Climate Citizen
feeds.description: Writings on climate change, sea level rise, ocean acidification, biodiversity loss, climate adaptation & protests from a Melbourne Citizen Journalist.

feeds.title: Indigenous Climate Hub Blog
feeds.description: Read latest resources, information and impactful stories on climate change, from Indigenous perspectives. Indigenous Climate Hub is a Indigenous-led project and national online platform for First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples, communities, and organizations.

feeds.title: Climate Stories Project Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Jason Davis about Climate change and the crisis we face due to it. Climate Stories Project (CSP) is an educational and artistic forum for sharing stories about personal and community responses to climate change. CSP focuses on personal oral histories, which bring an immediacy to the sometimes abstract nature of climate change communication.

feeds.title: Convenient Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my climate change blog. There are tips for reducing carbon emissions, some of which are about saving energy (and money!) - some are about saving petrol. There'll be some interesting news about renewable energy and transport, as well as some pieces about what the government is (or should be) doing.

feeds.title: Skeptical Science
feeds.description: Skeptical Science is a non-profit science education organization registered as a 501(c)(3) in the U.S., with the goal of raising public understanding of climate change. This is achieved through the publication of information and resources for educators, communicators, scientists, and the general public.

feeds.title: World Education Blog » Climate Change
feeds.description: This blog is curated by the Global Education Monitoring Report (GEM Report) which is editorially independent of UNESCO. We aim to raise fundamental questions about global education, especially on the particular themes of our annual report. We intend this blog to be a discussion forum for everyone interested in promoting the right to quality learning.

feeds.title: International Climate and Environmental Change Assessment Project
feeds.description: ICECAP is the portal to all things climate for elected officials and staffers, journalists, scientists, educators and the public. It provides access to a new and growing global society of respected scientists and journalists that are not deniers that our climate is dynamic

feeds.title: Campaign against Climate Change Trade Union Group Blog
feeds.description: The Campaign against Climate Change Trade Union Group is part of the Campaign against Climate Change. The One Million Climate Jobs campaign was set up by trade unionists within the Campaign against Climate Change, and is supported by a number of national unions, including PCS, CWU, UCU, TSSA, FBU, Unite, BFAWU and NUS.

feeds.title: Roy Spencer
feeds.description: Roy W. Spencer received his Ph.D. in meteorology at the University of Wisconsin-Madison in 1981. He was a Senior Scientist for Climate Studies at NASA's Marshall Space Flight Center. Dr. Spencer's research has been entirely supported by U.S. government agencies: NASA, NOAA, and DOE.

feeds.title: The Daily Climate
feeds.description: We push good journalism and science into public discussion and public policy on environmental health issues, including climate change.

feeds.title: The Global Climate and Health Alliance
feeds.description: The Global Climate and Health Alliance was formed in 2011. Alliance members are health organizations from around the world, united by a shared vision of a sustainable future. GCHA is uniquely positioned to engage and guide the rapidly growing movement of health professionals and health workers concerned about climate change, to drive the transformational change needed to address the climate emergency.

feeds.title: Climate for Health Blog
feeds.description: Founded by ecoAmerica, Climate for Health offers tools, resources, and communications to demonstrate visible climate leadership, inspiring and empowering health leaders to speak about, act on, and advocate for climate solutions. Be sure to look through our blog area to learn more about health and climate change. Learn the impact it is having on across our nation.

feeds.title: Canadian Climate Institute Blog
feeds.description: We are Canada's leading climate change policy research organization, producing the rigorous analysis and evidence-based recommendations that are needed to advance climate resilience, chart net zero pathways, and drive long-term prosperity. Check out the latest blog posts of the Canadian Climate Institute on various topics related to climate change and climate policy.

feeds.title: ClimateXChange
feeds.description: We provide independent advice, research and analysis to support the Scottish Government as it develops policies on adapting to the changing climate and transitioning to net zero. We provide timely research and expert advice to inform Scottish Government policymaking.

feeds.title: Climate Change Committee
feeds.description: The Climate Change Committee (CCC) is an independent, statutory body established under the Climate Change Act 2008. Our purpose is to advise the UK and devolved governments on emissions targets and to report to Parliament on progress made in reducing greenhouse gas emissions and preparing for and adapting to the impacts of climate change.

feeds.title: Job One for Humanity Blog
feeds.description: Job One for Humanity is a non-profit with an effective new plan for how to slow, lessen and survive global warming. It is based on current science and it provides practical, prioritized action steps you can start today and make a difference.

feeds.title: Judith Curry Blog
feeds.description: Climate Etc. provides a forum for climate researchers, academics and technical experts from other fields, citizen scientists, and the interested public to engage in a discussion on topics related to climate science and the science-policy interface.

feeds.title: Climate Strategies Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest climate policy analysis and opinion pieces from the Climate Strategies network. Climate Strategies works at the science-policy interface, advancing climate policy through meaningful interactions between decision-makers and researchers across Europe and internationally. We are an international, not-for-profit research network with an expansive network of world-leading researchers as members.

feeds.title: The Environmental Blog » Climate Change
feeds.description: The Environmental Blog started in early 2007 from an awakening and interest in environmental issues. I love writing about the environment, traveling, and capturing the world with my Lens as an amateur photographer.

feeds.title: Andy May Petrophysicist Blog
feeds.description: Andy May is a retired petrophysicist and has published four books. He worked in oil, gas, and CO2 fields in the USA, Argentina, Brazil, Indonesia, Thailand, China, the UK North Sea, Canada, Mexico, Venezuela, and Russia. He specialized in shale petrophysics, fractured reservoirs, wireline and core image interpretation, and capillary pressure analysis, besides conventional log analysis.

feeds.title: Tyndall Centre for Climate Change Research
feeds.description: We provide evidence to inform society's transition to a sustainable low-carbon and climate-resilient future. The Tyndall Centre is a partnership of universities bringing together researchers from the social and natural sciences and engineering to develop sustainable responses to climate change.

feeds.title: Clive Best Blog
feeds.description: I originally started this blog to record my experiences in Ethiopia. It started out as a travel blog, but has now morphed mainly into a science blog on climate.

feeds.title: Watts Up With That
feeds.description: Blog by Anthony Watts. I'm a former AMS certified (Seal 676 retired) television meteorologist who spent 25 years on the air and who also operates a weather technology and content business, as well as continues daily forecasting on radio, just for fun. Here you will find News and commentary on puzzling things in life, nature, science, weather, climate change, technology and more.

feeds.title: UK Youth Climate Coalition Blog
feeds.description: Our MISSION is to mobilize and empower young people to take positive action for global climate justice. We are a group of 18-29-year-olds who volunteer and collaborate to work towards creating our VISION of a just, sustainable world in which current and future generations enjoy and protect a healthy environment.

feeds.title: Citizens' Climate Lobby Blog
feeds.description: Citizens' Climate Lobby is a climate change organization that exists to create the political will for a livable world by enabling individual breakthroughs in the exercise of personal and political power. Our climate change blog covers the latest news on climate change solutions, global warming, and carbon fees and dividends.

feeds.title: Protego Terra Blog
feeds.description: Your blog about climate change & sustainability. Sara Giovarruscio is the passionate founder of Protegoterra, a knowledge platform dedicated to empowering people to take action on climate change & sustainability.

feeds.title: Hothouse
feeds.description: Hothouse is original climate journalism with a way to act. We dig into the evidence, figure out what works, and deliver the news to you.

feeds.title: ClimateDog
feeds.description: Action steps to protect families and communities from the costs of climate change.

feeds.title: Campaign against Climate Change Blog
feeds.description: Read latest news, campaigns and fundraisers by Campaign against Climate Change. CCC pushes for the urgent and radical action that need to prevent the catastrophic destabilisation of the global climate.

feeds.title: Actuaries Digital » Climate Change
feeds.description: Read articles by Alex Pui and Sileem Horie on the climatology of the polar vortex and the unique circumstances and vulnerability of locations most impacted. They also offer suggestions on how societies can better economically prepare for similar storms in the future.

feeds.title: Trees, Fish, and Dreams Climateblog
feeds.description: This blog is about climate change, rivers, salmon and steelhead fishing, Pacific Northwest people, and ecopoetry.

feeds.title: ClimateChange.ie
feeds.description: Read Ireland's one-stop source of information and opinion on environmental, climate change and related issues. They aims to bring together the most up to date credible sources, both national and international.

feeds.title: Eric Grimsrud
feeds.description: On the science and implications of climate change by Eric Grimsrud.

feeds.title: Inside track » Climate Change
feeds.description: Posts about Climate change written by Joe Dodd. Green Alliance's blog on environmental policy and politics.

feeds.title: PRIO Climate & Conflict Blog
feeds.description: The Climate & Conflict blog provides updates on events, publications, and activities of PRIO-based research projects on the relationship between environmental change and violent conflict.

feeds.title: Global Climate Change Week Blog
feeds.description: Global Climate Change Week (GCCW) encourages academic communities - including academics, students, and non-academic staff at universities - in all disciplines and countries to engage with each other, their communities, and policymakers on climate change action and solutions.

feeds.title: Climate Change The Facts Blog
feeds.description: Climate Change The Facts is the definitive guide to the latest international research and analysis on climate change science and policy.

feeds.title: Climate Change AI Blog
feeds.description: Climate Change AI (CCAI) is an organization composed of volunteers from academia and industry who believe that tackling climate change requires concerted societal action, in which machine learning can play an impactful role. Since it was founded in June 2019, CCAI has led the creation of a global movement in climate change and machine learning, encompassing researchers, and more.

feeds.title: IMF Blogs
feeds.description: Read insights, breaking new alerts on climate from the International Monetary Fund. IMFBlog is a forum for the views of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) staff and officials on pressing economic and policy issues of the day.

feeds.title: The Green Market Oracle
feeds.description: Read about a comprehensive source of news and information on climate change, sustainable development and green economy. The convergence of sustainable capitalism and the global environment.

feeds.title: WWF Blog
feeds.description: Latest news and articles on climate and energy change by WWE. They believe that the level of global warming we're heading for will cost countless lives, derail development and devastate the ecosystems upon which we all depend, and which WWF has fought so hard to protect.

feeds.title: UK Health Alliance Blog
feeds.description: Reporting on the latest news and reports on the intersection of climate and health. UKHACC brings together health professionals to advocate for responses to climate change that protect & promote public health.

feeds.title: Climate Interactive Blog
feeds.description: Latest news, updates on climate change, global warming and disaster management. Climate Interactive is an independent, not-for-profit think-tank that grew out of MIT Sloan in Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA. Based on a long tradition of system dynamics modeling, their simulations and insights help people see connections, play out scenarios, and see what works to address climate change, inequity, and related issues like energy, health, and food.

feeds.title: Royal Irish Academy Blog » Climate Change
feeds.description: Read from Ireland's leading body of experts in sciences & humanities about research and projects on climate change and global warming. They are identified and recognised as Ireland's world class researchers. They support scholarship and promote awareness of how science and the humanities enrich our lives and benefit society.

feeds.title: Arctic News
feeds.description: The Arctic-News Blog describes the situation in the Arctic, focusing especially on the threat of large abrupt methane eruptions from the Arctic Ocean seafloor. Contributors to the blog share a deep concern about the way climate change is unfolding in the Arctic and the threat that this poses for the world at large.

feeds.title: Climate Action Blog
feeds.description: We address issues around climate change and the environment in the North East of England and provide practical solutions and actions for local groups, communities, schools, and businesses in the region.

feeds.title: CABI » Climate Change And Biodiversity
feeds.description: CABI is an international, inter-governmental, not-for-profit organization that improves people's lives worldwide by providing information and applying scientific expertise to solve problems in agriculture and the environment. Read about Climate Change And Biodiversity in the following section of CABI.

feeds.title: Climate Council
feeds.description: Climate Council is Australia's own independent, evidence-based organization on climate science, impacts, and solutions. We connect decision-makers, the public, and the media to catalyze action at scale, elevate climate stories in the news and shape the conversation on climate consequences and action, at home and abroad.
